name: BSC swap router unauthenticated uniswapV3SwapCallback pays any approver
summary: The unverified UUPS swap router 0xa331fde0 (implementation 0x241f743e) has a public swap entry, selector 0x33411b5e, that calls swap() on any caller-named V3 route pool. Its uniswapV3SwapCallback (0xfa461e33) accepts a call from any msg.sender and runs transferFrom(payer, msg.sender, amount), with the payer decoded from the callback data. It neither checks that the caller is a factory-deployed pool nor binds the payer to the swap initiator. An attacker-deployed fake pool re-entered the callback with victims as payer, pulling 29 approvers' tokens through their standing router allowances. Four later actors repeated the path before the router was paused.

loss.notes: Components are victims' tokens pulled by router transferFrom calls in which the payer is outside the attacker's addresses. Each is valued at the attacker's same-transaction disposal of that token: WBNB (plus USDT at par) received from the token's sale counterparties, minus the WBNB the attacker spent on that token's seed purchase. Seed round trips and the 1 WBNB flash-swap fee are attacker inputs. The main campaign, source-1, has 59 callbacks across 29 victims, 32 victim-token pairs and 8 tokens. Its components sum to 46.643086 WBNB plus 11550.468529943177031310 USDT, plus 6.924275 USDC at par. The attacker EOA received 62.284129499372716328 BNB. Copycat campaigns (source-7): 0x8d5b56cc (pDOG, FLORK, plus the "1" token, whose loot was returned to its pair unsold and is valued at DefiLlama), 0x1cac5af9 (b-money, Priceless, 淘公仔, Q币) and 0x8cc42905. De minimis copycat loot not added: 0x8cc42905's two transactions netted 0.009574 and 0.002442 WBNB, and the PONKE, SPCXB and CDL residues are under 1 USD. Loot kept unsold and unpriced is not valued, so the total is a lower bound for those transactions: 0x8d5b56cc's 0x3fa0fbbe (BEE, 黑马, GALIA) and 0xfa20e2bd's four transactions (13 low-cap tokens held in 0x9a9eb282). Unit values from realised disposals are below DefiLlama spot where available (Max 0.01346 vs 0.01490, OCEAN 9.59e-10 vs 1.37e-9 USD).

ageReset.description: The 16th Upgraded event after construction installs implementation 0x241f743e, created one transaction earlier in the same block (index 50) by the router owner. The next upgrade, to 0x50c08665 at block 120550401, comes after every merged campaign.

limitations: Proxy and implementation are unverified. The callback defect is established from callTracer frames and calldata, not from source code.

sources.note: Reviewed anchor, root cause, earliest use and age. eth_getTransactionReceipt(source-1): status 1, block 120524634, index 1. It is a contract creation by 0xb929c7215c0ec8ebad5fbf73b1da63bccfff1896; the constructor deploys 0x46adc596, which deploys fake pool 0xaeaedec462bc82e27faf6efedd8ff95e1d526273. debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) shows a 1 WBNB PancakeV2 flash swap from 0x58f87685 and 59 repetitions of the following. 0x46adc596 calls router 0xa331fde0 selector 0x33411b5e (delegatecall to 0x241f743e) with route pool = 0xaeaedec4. The router calls 0xaeaedec4.swap (0x128acb08). 0xaeaedec4 calls router uniswapV3SwapCallback (0xfa461e33). The router runs token.transferFrom(victim, 0xaeaedec4, amount) for 29 distinct victims, none of them attacker addresses. There is no factory or getPool call in any callback frame, and eth_call factoryV3() on the router returns zero at blocks 104346525, 118951369, 118951370, 120524633 and 121000000. Earliest use: Etherscan getLogs on the router for topic 0x3145c7c5a7804148dd68148a26f9f6a2ad2816be643e0f456290a8b81b9c5154 (one event per swap entry), blocks 104346524-124600000, returns 2878 events in 2694 transactions. All 2345 transactions before source-1 (321 of them after the implementation change) are direct EOA calls in the router txlist; the first non-direct (contract-originated) transactions are source-1 and the 11 source-7 transactions. ABI-decoding every successful direct 0x33411b5e call (tuple (uint256,address,address,address,uint256,uint256,uint256,bytes)[],uint256,uint256,uint256,uint256,address,bytes, non-strict) gives 130 distinct kind-1 (V3) route pools. For every one, factory().getPool(token0, token1, fee) returns the pool itself on the PancakeV3 (0x0BFbCF9f..) or UniswapV3 (0xdB1d1001..) factory. Kind-8/9 pools are third-party factory deployments. So no earlier swap used a non-genuine callback caller. Age: EIP-1967 Upgraded (0xbc7cd75a...) getLogs on the proxy returns 17 events, from construction at block 104346524 (0xa2737325) to 0xc700cf8d at 120724906. Source-3 (block 118951370, index 51, log 294) sets topic1 0x241f743e. The implementation slot is 0x0ba127f5... at block 118951369 and 0x241f743e at 118951370 and 120524633. The next event, 0x50c08665 at block 120550401, follows the pause() call 0xf2011ca1... at block 120541220. The 0x241f743e creation receipt 0x5add8e38d7c3b4251f7614a31490220a8c6b68075422f48c658c11c1091b5d9f (block 118951370, index 50, from owner 0x2803e636) precedes the upgrade. Implementation code is empty at 118951369, and its keccak equals the recorded hash at 118951370, 120524633 and 120539951. Proxy code is empty at 104346523 and hashes to 0x681bb8a5... at 104346524 and 120524633. Owner transactions between the upgrade and source-1 are two rescue(address,address,uint256) calls at block 118951431 that withdraw router dust. The admin slot is 0 (UUPS).

Main-campaign loss recipe for source-1. Sum the router-originated transferFrom frames by token (payer, recipient 0xaeaedec4). Loot per token equals the Transfer logs from victims: Max 2740628.127607454226293791, OCEAN 9268105110950.016905171 (9 decimals), USDC 6.924275, SATURN 29910.904943654694204808, KOPI 8018338.588507343906428055, Kandura 4136465.745046839277137256, MarsCoin 363.868625679307602512. Proceeds are Transfer logs between 0x46adc596 and each token's sale pair. Max: pair 0xa2b1926c pays 34.514180989303891821 WBNB (seed 0.02 WBNB paid), and pair 0x16d6c619 pays 11493.091359582576621585 USDT. OCEAN: pair 0xb9b40e16 pays 12.100061827668280003 WBNB (seed 0.02). SATURN (0x9b389424), KOPI (0x3b18e0c1) and Kandura (0xd628404d) pay 0.019495343756503215, 0.041784882045298817 and 0.024563027718409311 WBNB (0.005 seed each). MarsCoin: seed bought from 0x9f286c9b for 0.002 WBNB, sold to 0x14ca9d55 for 57.377170360600409725 USDT. The USDC loot is valued at par. For each token, tokens sent out by the attacker equal loot plus seed, so everything was sold. Total WBNB net 62.284129499372716328 goes to the EOA (0x46adc596 -> 0xd0347dd0 -> 0xb929c721).

Copycat recipe (source-7). Trace each transaction and keep router transferFrom frames whose payer is outside the transaction's sender, target and created contracts. Walk receipt Transfer logs in order: each loot token's segment runs from the attacker's WBNB seed payment to a counterparty through the WBNB paid back by it. 0x5a8cc4d2 (0x8d5b56cc, block 120530393): pDOG 21368922.167512435815104153 loot sold to pair 0xd8f54d30 for 0.171010850495462275 WBNB (log 325), flash-borrowed seed repaid. 0xb87f97da (0x1cac5af9, 120531777): b-money 1038522.999102498236583565 -> 11.3815873243457093 WBNB (log 195), Priceless 288800.486925568031627724 -> 0.193012956965916154 (log 424), 淘公仔 749502.411533640418361595 -> 0.027474674480193704 (log 547), each less a 0.001 WBNB seed. 0xe8158ab5 (0x8d5b56cc, 120533560): FLORK 2438.337046170788665774 -> 37.239415627448130918 USDT (log 240). "1" 148387.198764425207076199 and CDL 125.92 were pushed into their pairs unsold. 0xc8b49263 (0x1cac5af9, 120533585): Q币 2485843.464636007211814984 -> 0.736475291998361571 WBNB (log 361) less 0.001 seed. The router was paused at block 120541220, after the last source-7 transaction.
